issues: The README states a GPU requirement: 'It takes 10 GB VRAM for shape generation, 21GB for texture generation and 29GB for shape and texture generation in total', and installs CUDA torch (cu124) plus CUDA-compiled rasterizers. The exam carved out a CPU-only, shape-only, 10-step variant the README never offers.

Measured on our 4-vCPU box: one 10-step bf16 run takes ~505-593 s per diffusion step (~85 min of sampling before VAE decode), and the unpatched pipeline was OOM-killed (exit 137) while building the 3.3B DiT; the agent had to patch hy3dshape/pipelines.py to fit memory.
Oracle bug regardless: its inner `timeout 6000` exceeds the harness ORACLE_SEC=3600, so the test could never finish in budget.

The duplicate audit's 'oracle re-run passed' in 18 s cannot be a real CPU generation; it read a shape.glb left in /tmp/oracle_out.WsxvtU by an earlier oracle process that outlived the harness timeout.
